summary: Houston County, TN tower at 820 ft; a 1975-76 worker's reader comment names it. The 2014 National Register extant table omits it. Access unknown.

facts.status_note: Listed standing in January 2026, but missing from the 2014 survey of extant towers; current condition not confirmed.

events.note: Reader's comment (not an official record): summer 1975 to summer 1976 work for the Division at its towers in Stewart and Houston counties, including painting the Erin Fire Tower

evidence.supports: Erin in Houston County at 820 ft, code 6-20, standing; list gives no build or design details
list was last revised in January 2026
commenter worked for the Division at its fire towers in the Stewart and Houston county area in 1975-76
evidence.quote: I actually worked at all of the Tennessee Forestry Division fire towers in the Stewart and Houston county area during this time.

evidence.supports: work ran from summer 1975 until summer 1976
evidence.quote: Right after high school I worked here with the Tennessee Forestry Division from the summer of 1975 until the summer of 1976

evidence.supports: crews painted the Erin Fire Tower along with other towers
evidence.quote: I helped paint this entire fire tower from top to bottom and we also painted all of the other fire towers including the Model Fire Tower, the Big A Fire Tower and the Erin Fire Tower.

evidence.supports: crews kept grounds clear and also fought fires
evidence.quote: We fought fires, painted everything and kept the grass and weeds cut and clipped.

evidence.supports: the Houston County entry in the extant table is Towerview; Erin is not listed
evidence.quote: Springdale Claiborne Towerview Houston Slaven Knob Scott

evidence.supports: extant table is dated as of March 26, 2014
evidence.quote: Extant Tennessee Fire Towers as of March 26, 2014

evidence.supports: register's Tennessee list has 76 lookouts; Erin is not among them
evidence.quote: There are 76 lookouts registered in Tennessee.

notes_for_editor: Status conflict: the Tennessee Landforms list (revised January 2026) marks Erin standing, but the 2014 National Register extant table lists only Towerview in Houston County. facts.status is set to 'unconfirmed' until someone checks on the ground or with the Division. The only staffing evidence is one anonymous reader comment on the LBL site about 1975-76; it is cited as a comment and the story says so. Business directory listings for an 'Erin Fire Tower' at 2722 Fire Tower Road turned up in search but were not used. The 'Towerview Farm' in Erin in the cache is unrelated to the tower. No build date, design, height, fire history or access information found. Search budget: 2 web searches; page reads shared across the three lookouts.
